sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are in outstanding form with five consecutive wins and sit top of the table on 22 points from 10 games, while Alsager Town arrive as one of the division's struggling sides on just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match that could have title-race implications, with Stafford on 20 points seeking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19 points) host Eccleshall (5th, 18 points) in a direct top-five clash between in-form sides, while Wolverhampton Casuals (4th, 19 points) face Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) welcome Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Among the lower reaches, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle between two of the weakest sides, while Shawbury United host Barnton and Crewe face Allscott Heath. Widnes Town, pointless with just 2 points, travel to Brereton Social, and Market Drayton Town visit New Mills in matches involving sides struggling near the foot of the table.
